description: An angular representation of knee flexion or extension based on the system's joint model.
patient_explanation: This describes how much the knee is bent or extended.

description: The elevation of the lower leg relative to a reference orientation.
patient_explanation: This shows how far the lower leg was raised.

description: The measured time between movement onset and the target or peak lift phase.
patient_explanation: This shows how long it took to raise the leg.

description: The time the exercise position remained within the system's configured hold condition.
patient_explanation: This shows how long the position was held.

description: The rate of change of limb orientation.
patient_explanation: This describes how quickly the limb moved.

description: A derived measure related to abrupt changes in acceleration or movement.
patient_explanation: A larger value may mean the movement was less smooth, depending on system calibration.

description: A system-specific comparison of left-side and right-side movement behavior.
patient_explanation: This compares movement between the two sides.

description: The angle of the trunk relative to a reference vertical direction.
patient_explanation: This shows how far the upper body leaned.
